summary: A steel lookout tower at Gypsumville is dated to 1947; an August 1948 newspaper item says an 80-foot steel tower was still being erected.

facts.design: steel fire lookout tower, about 80 ft (24 m) according to the 1948 item

events.note: A steel tower was erected, as dated by the Manitoba Department of Mines and Natural Resources annual report and cited by Canada Lookouts.

Newspaper item of 9 August 1948 (credited to the Lundar Interlake Observer and The Winnipeg Tribune on the page): an 80-foot steel tower being erected under supervision of Forest Ranger Emil Campbell. Conflicts with the 1947 date.

evidence.supports: Gypsumville is on the north bank of Lake St. Martin in Manitoba's Interlake Region
evidence.quote: It is 242 kilometres north-northwest of Winnipeg in the Interlake Region of Manitoba on the north bank of Lake St. Martin

evidence.supports: steel tower dated to 1947, citing the annual report
80-foot steel fire lookout tower being erected in August 1948 under supervision of Forest Ranger Emil Campbell
evidence.quote: An 80-foot steel fire lookout tower is being erected at Gypsumville under supervision of Forest Ranger Emil Campbell.

evidence.supports: tower would afford a very good outlook (source: excellent view) of the surrounding country and help with fire control
evidence.quote: This will afford an excellent view of the surrounding country and aid in fire control.

evidence.supports: the two dates disagree; the sources do not settle when the tower was finished
lookout listed under the Eastern Forest District; this is the only page checked and it says nothing about the site today

notes_for_editor: Unresolved conflict: the annual report summary dates the steel tower to 1947, but the August 1948 item describes it as being erected. The record's 1947 built event is kept; the 1948 item is recorded as an 'other' event so nothing is claimed about completion. The newspaper gives 80 ft; it does not say whether that is to the cab floor, so no height_m is set. No agency is set: the annual report is cited for the date, not as evidence of the owning agency. No source found on the site today. A 1986 Canadian Forces Station history for Gypsumville was searched for lookout mentions and had none. Record has no local_unit; the Rural Municipality of Grahamdale appears only in Wikipedia and is not used.
